purpose: Teach: 真っ暗/滅多に/遥か/真夏/呆れ/入り込ん/通り過ぎ/つづき

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、教室、真っ暗にして怖がらせたろ?
lines.en: Riku — you darkened the classroom to scare everyone, didn't you?
lines.style: Direct accusation with a hint of amusement underneath. Sharp, quick opening. Keeping him on his toes. The tone of someone calling out a friend mid-prank.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、滅多に怒らないけど、今日は怒ってたな、桜
lines.en: You don't get angry often, but you were mad today, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet observation, testing the waters. Measured delivery. Noticing something real beneath her teasing. Not quite defensive — more like he's figured something out and isn't sure he should say it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の家、遥か学校から離れてるよな
lines.en: Your place is really far from school, isn't it?
lines.style: Softer shift. A small realization landing. Slow pace. Like she's putting something together just as she speaks. Not quite question, not quite statement.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、真夏に部活、すげえ頑張ったな、桜
lines.en: You worked insanely hard at club activities all through summer, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine recognition without ceremony. Steady voice. Acknowledging effort he saw and she maybe didn't know he noticed. Warm but not sentimental.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ぼくの忘れ物に呆れただろ?
lines.en: You were exasperated with me for forgetting things again, weren't you?
lines.style: Self-aware wryness with a thin edge of actual vulnerability underneath. Light, deflecting with humor. But the question is real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、図書室に入り込んで漫画読んだろ?桜
lines.en: You snuck into the library and read manga the whole time, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle teasing, caught red-handed. Fond accusation. Slow warm delivery. The slight laughter of someone who knows her better than she thinks.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ぼくが通り過ぎたのに気づかなかったろ
lines.en: You didn't even notice me when I walked past you.
lines.style: Wry observation delivered quietly. No edge — more like stating a small, true fact. The faintest smile underneath. Not accusatory, just noticing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、宿題のつづき、明日やれよ、桜
lines.en: Finish your homework tomorrow, okay, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle directive, not an order. Warm, almost careful. The voice of someone used to being listened to without needing to command. Slight fadeout on her name.
